keyEvents.text: Salih Özcan (Besiktas) is shown the yellow card.
Jonas Malede (Hapoel Be'er Sheva) is shown the yellow card.
Delay in match because of an injury Emirhan Topçu (Besiktas).
Delay over. They are ready to continue.
Penalty saved. Orkun Kökçü (Besiktas) right footed shot saved in the bottom left corner by Marco Wolff (Hapoel Be'er Sheva).
First Half ends, Besiktas 0, Hapoel Be'er Sheva 0.
Substitution, Besiktas. Yasin Özcan replaces Emirhan Topçu because of an injury.
Second Half begins Besiktas 0, Hapoel Be'er Sheva 0.
Substitution, Besiktas. Dusan Vlahovic replaces Oh Hyeon-Gyu.
Substitution, Besiktas. Junior Olaïtan replaces Wilfred Ndidi.
Substitution, Besiktas. Leandro Trossard replaces Ilhan Fakılı.
Substitution, Hapoel Be'er Sheva. João Victor replaces Jonas Malede.
